stem: A single HLVd test is negative. What should determine how strongly that result supports release?
choices: Only whether the plant looked healthy.
Whether the result was printed in color.
Sample identity, plant part, timing, sampling design, assay/method controls and the facility decision rule.
Whether the room has ever had insects.
rationale: A test result supports only the sampled material and method under the applicable decision rule; sampling and identity determine inference strength.
